meta.title: SLATE research: parkrun, adult social sports leagues, free running clubs and volunteering platforms in the eight towns
meta.method: WebSearch to find each organisation; WebFetch or curl (with a browser user agent where WebFetch was refused with 403) to read the organisation's own page. parkrun's own event list (https://images.parkrun.com/events.json) was downloaded and the nearest events to each town centre were found by straight-line (haversine) distance from these town-centre coordinates: New York 40.7128,-74.006; Los Angeles 34.0522,-118.2437; New Haven 41.3083,-72.9279; London 51.5074,-0.1278; Dublin 53.3498,-6.2603; Toronto 43.6532,-79.3832; Vancouver 49.2827,-123.1207; Mexico City 19.4326,-99.1332. Each parkrun event page was then read for its day, time, cost and any cancellation notice. 'confirmed: true' means the figure was read on the organisation's own page on 2026-10-03; 'confirmed: false' means it came from a third-party page or a search-engine summary and the note says which. Nothing is invented; where nothing was found the value is null and notes.notFound says so.
meta.currencyNotes: USD for US towns, GBP for London, EUR for Dublin, CAD for Toronto and Vancouver. Mexico City: no league figure found.

parkrun.cost: Free; register once with parkrun before first run and bring a scannable barcode
parkrun.note: Page: 'Every Saturday at 8:00am (May - October) & 9:00am (November - April).' Cancellation notice on the page: 'Brooklyn Bridge parkrun is cancelled on Oct 10, 2026 - Venue unavailable'. 1.5 km from the town-centre point. Next nearest: Branch Brook Park parkrun (Newark NJ, 15.8 km) and Saddle River County parkrun (NJ, 23.8 km).

No parkrun in Mexico in parkrun's own event list. The nearest events are in the Houston area of Texas (Terry Hershey parkrun, about 1,203 km straight-line). A Mexico City resident has no parkrun.

leagues.note: Listing reads '$135/player · $2,430/team' with the page's fees-included toggle on; it says fees, not tax. Other NYC listings on the same page: Thursday Basketball, Prospect Park (John Jay HS), 7PM-10PM, from 10/8 for 7 weeks, $99/player; Thursday GLOW Bocce, West Village (Pier 25), 7PM-10PM, 6 weeks, $75/player; Thursday Women's Basketball, Williamsburg, 7 weeks, $119/player; Saturday Volleyball, Williamsburg, 2PM-5PM, from 10/10 for 7 weeks, $119/player. gamesPerWeek=1 follows Volo's stated one game per week on its LA kickball page and is assumed, not read, for this NYC league. ZogSports NY's own registration site (zogsportsny.leagueapps.com/leagues) showed 'No programs at this time' and gives nyc@volosports.com as its contact; the last ZogSports figure read there was Summer 2022 West Village weeknight kickball, individual $115 early / $125 regular / $135 late, 6 games plus a playoff week; that is stale and is recorded here only as history.

leagues.dayTime: Monday and Wednesday listing, 7:15PM-10:15PM, Immaculate Heart High School, Hollywood; starts 10/19 (2026)
leagues.note: Listing reads '$84.66/player · $1,085.75/team' with fees included; tax not stated. Volo's LA kickball page (https://www.volosports.com/los-angeles/kickball) says '7 weeks of regular-season play followed by 1 playoff week, with one scheduled game each week'. The listing is shown as 'Monday, Wednesday'; whether a player plays both nights or picks one was not stated. Other LA listings: Monday Softball, Sherman Oaks, 7PM-10PM, from 10/5 for 9 weeks, $84.66/player; Saturday Softball, Culver City, 11AM-2PM, 9 weeks, $100.78/player; Mon/Wed Beach Volleyball, Santa Monica Pier Courts, 9 weeks, $116.91/player; Tue/Thu Soccer, Hollywood, 8 weeks, $116.91/player.

leagues.dayTime: Thursdays, games between 6:15pm and 9pm, 50 Loomis Place, New Haven
leagues.note: Page: individual $60 early (by June 1st), $65 regular (by July 5th); includes T-shirt, '8 weeks of games', bar specials and opening/closing party. Dates on the page are 'Thursdays: July 8th to August 19th' (7 Thursdays); July 8 falls on a Thursday in 2021, not 2026, so the page is probably an old season and the figures may be stale. A Fall kickball option is listed on the site but its details were not read. No tax stated.

leagues.dayTime: Monday, games between 7pm-9pm, Park Sports Hyde Park (South Carriage Drive, W2 2UH); starts 02/11/2026
leagues.note: GO Mammoth prices per week, not per season: '£11.10 p/wk JOIN AS INDIVIDUAL', '£7.50 p/wk* JOIN AS TEAM' (*team price based on a 10-person squad). Duration '8-9 weeks', so an individual season is £88.80-£99.90 (derived: 11.10 x 8 or 9, not a page figure). Page status: 'League almost FULL'. The London netball page says individuals 'From £7 per week', seasons '8-12 weeks', and that over 70% of players join alone. No VAT statement found on either page. 40-minute fixtures, umpires and equipment included.

leagues.sport: Tag rugby: 'Just For Craic' social tag for individuals (Sandymount Mondays)
leagues.dayTime: Monday, Pembroke Cricket Club, Sandymount; starts 14/09/2026
leagues.note: Read on ITRA's registration system (Autumn 2026). Individual €32.00; teams for the same venue €760.00. Another individual option: Drumcondra Tuesdays - Mixed Social, Belvedere Rugby Grounds, from 22/09/2026, 9 weeks, individual €39.50 (team €760.00). ITRA's individuals page (https://www.tagrugby.ie/join) gives times: Drumcondra Tuesdays 18:45/19:45 (alternating), Drumcondra Wednesdays 18:45, 19:30, 20:15, Milltown Tuesdays 18:45 or 19:30, Irishtown Thursdays 19:10; individuals get a WhatsApp link a week before the start. Sandymount Monday kick-off time not read. No VAT statement.

leagues.dayTime: Weeknights, most leagues at 6:45 pm; season from the week of May 11 to August 30, 2026 (week 17 held for rain-outs)
leagues.note: Page: individual '$190 ($168.14 + HST)', i.e. $190 includes 13% HST. Smaller formats: Wednesday West 6-on-6 '$80 ($70.80 + HST)', Thursday Lamport 6-on-6 '$85 ($75.22 + HST)' (Lamport slots 7:00-8:10, 8:15-9:25, 9:30-10:40 pm). A 2026/2027 TUC membership (valid April 1 2026 - March 31 2027) is also required; its price was not read. The 2026 winter league (https://www.tuc.org/adults/winter) was individual '$295 ($261.06 + HST)' for 13 weeks, January 27/28 - April 21/22 2026. Toronto Sport & Social Club now redirects to JAM Sports (JAM Toronto, 'formerly Toronto Sport and Social Club'); its league prices load by script and could not be read.

leagues.organiser: Urban Rec (Vancouver's Sport and Social Club)
leagues.dayTime: Thursday 8:00 PM - 11:00 PM, UBC; starts 10 Sep 2026
leagues.note: Page: 'Team Registration: $1695.00 (Tax Included) Individual Registration: $195.00 (Tax Included)'; 'Length: 12 weeks'; coed, all skill levels, played without the offside rule. Search summaries also gave UBC Wednesday Soccer individual $180.00 (tax included) and Richmond Oval Tuesday individual soccer $175.00 (tax included, 12 weeks, from 15 Sep 2026); those two were not read on the page. The Vancouver Sport & Social Club domain vssc.ca refused the connection; Urban Rec calls itself Vancouver's Sport and Social Club.

runningClubs.meetingPoint: Park entrance at West 110th Street and Manhattan Avenue (down the stairs), Manhattan
runningClubs.distance: 3 miles listed as the registration option
runningClubs.note: NYRR FAQ: 'NYRR Open Run is completely free'; check-in 15 minutes before start. Sign-up on the NYRR site ('Sign Up to Run!'). The programme page (https://www.nyrr.org/open-run) also lists Inwood Hill Park Saturdays 09:00, Shore Road Park Saturdays 09:00, Soundview and St. Mary's Park Saturdays 09:00, Flushing Meadows Corona Park Thursdays 07:00 PM, and notices: Highland Park cancelled Saturday Oct 10; St. Mary's cancelled Saturday Oct 3; Lincoln Park cancelled Sunday Oct 4.

runningClubs.meetingPoint: Franklin's Cafe, 2650 N Vermont Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90027 (Griffith Park)
runningClubs.note: Page: 'WE ARE A FREE RUNNING AND FITNESS GROUP MEETING EVERY SUNDAY IN GRIFFITH PARK.'

runningClubs.club: Faxon Law New Haven Road Race weekly group runs
runningClubs.meetingPoint: East Rock Brewing Co, 285 Nicoll Street, New Haven
runningClubs.note: Seasonal: 'July 1 - September 2' (Wednesdays from July 1; July 1 2026 is a Wednesday), so the 2026 series had ended by 2026-10-03. Runners get $2 off pretzels and full pours at the brewery afterwards. New Haven Road Runners (https://www.newhavenroadrunners.com/) runs year-round weekly runs but a search summary gave a $20 a year social membership; not read on its page.

Page: 'Our runs on Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday leave from 21 Druid Street. Make a profile on the website, then just turn up!' and 'the largest running club in London that is free to join'. Start times are not on the home page; a third-party summary gave Tuesday and Thursday 7pm and Sunday 9.30am and 11.30am (not confirmed).

runningClubs.cost: First run free as a guest; membership is a €10 club fee plus annual Athletics Ireland registration
runningClubs.distance: Mostly 5 to 10 km in pace groups
runningClubs.note: Not free to join: the page says 'there's a small €10 club fee on top of your annual Athletics Ireland registration' (Athletics Ireland fee not given there). Its Couch to 5K programme is 'Free to take part'. Free social alternatives from third-party summaries, not read on an own site: Run Club Social (Tuesday evenings at The Storyteller pub, Sunday mornings in Clontarf), The Urban Run Project (Thursday 5 km in Sandymount, free), Happy Feet Run Club (Saturdays 9:30am twice a month, Chapelizod 10 km / Dun Laoghaire 5 km; its own page gave no price).

runningClubs.meetingPoint: 124 Brock Ave, Toronto, ON M6K 2L4 (Stay Gold)
runningClubs.note: Read on the host venue Stay Gold's page ('Tuesdays @ 7:00PM - Rain or Shine', 'FREE social run'), not on Parkdale Roadrunners' own site (parkdaleroadrunners.com, not read). A third-party summary gave 4-6 km and 7-10 km options. Note: BlackToe Running's Tuesday run club is not free ($49.00 CAD a month, 3-month minimum: https://www.blacktoerunning.com/products/blacktoe-run-club-king-west-tuesday).

runningClubs.club: Vancouver Running Company Flight Crew Run Club
runningClubs.cost: Free; no registration for weekly road runs (participation waiver before first run)
runningClubs.note: Page: 'fun, free and social group runs', 'Weekly Thursday (6:15pm)'. Monthly trail runs at 8:30am (8 km & 11 km) require registration.

runningClubs.meetingPoint: Varies: City Café El Sope (Jul 18), Cuemanco (Aug 15), Cárcamo de Dolores (Sep 19)
runningClubs.note: Martí's run club page (https://www.marti.mx/run-club): 'Nuestro programa de entrenamiento es gratuito'; join by attending a run and registering by QR code at the end. The guided-routes page listed only July-September Saturday sessions; no October date was shown. It is monthly, not weekly. Nike Run Club and adidas Runners CDMX free weekly sessions appear only in third-party summaries (not confirmed).

volunteering.howToSignUp: Search opportunities on nycservice.org by date, location and impact area, then sign up for a listed opportunity (registration at /Registration).
volunteering.note: NYC311 (https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-01392) points to NYC Service. No fee mentioned.

volunteering.howToSignUp: Create an account on the L.A. Works volunteer portal (volunteer.laworks.com) via its Getting Started page, then use the opportunity search or event calendar.
volunteering.note: No fee mentioned on the page.

volunteering.platform: United Way of Greater New Haven
volunteering.howToSignUp: Use the 'Volunteer Opportunities' link on the volunteer page to sign up for listed events; questions to the Volunteer and Engagement Coordinator.
volunteering.note: Page: 'Take action and sign up to volunteer today.' No fee mentioned.

volunteering.platform: Simply Volunteer London (Mayor of London / GLA supported)
volunteering.howToSignUp: Click 'Become a volunteer' to create an account, then search volunteering roles across Greater London.
volunteering.note: Replaced the Team London Volunteering website in March 2024 (per search summary of london.gov.uk; the GLA page itself returned 403). The site carries the GLA logo and a Mayor of London quote. No fee mentioned.

volunteering.platform: Volunteer Ireland / I-VOL and the local Volunteer Centre (Dublin City Volunteer Centre)
volunteering.howToSignUp: Register on www.i-vol.ie or contact the local Volunteer Centre, which discusses interests, skills and time and matches you to roles.
volunteering.cost: Mostly free: 'The majority of services offered by your local Volunteer Centre are completely free!'

volunteering.howToSignUp: Search the volunteer opportunity database (by category, type of position or city area) and apply to the organisation; Volunteer Advisors can help.
volunteering.note: volunteertoronto.ca returned 403 to both WebFetch and curl; details come from a search-engine summary of its pages.

volunteering.platform: Vantage Point (Vancouver's volunteer centre) via Volunteer Connector
volunteering.howToSignUp: Search and apply for opportunities on Volunteer Connector (volunteerconnector.org), which Vantage Point's GoVolunteer page directs to.
volunteering.note: Page: 'Find volunteer opportunities and engage dedicated volunteers through Volunteer Connector.' No fee mentioned.

volunteering.howToSignUp: Choose a mode (in person in the permanent volunteer corps, virtual, corporate or community); register a profile on the #Soy Voluntario platform (soyvoluntario.cruzrojamexicana.org.mx).
volunteering.note: The four modes were read on the page. The five-step process (register profile, upload documents and book an interview, profile review, institutional training, choose a programme) and the 18+ age requirement come from a search summary only; the platform page did not render its text.

notFound: Mexico City adult social sports league with an individual (free agent) fee: none found on an organiser's own page. TOCA Fútbol's Mexico City adult league page gives no format, schedule or price; a Sportwey listing (LIGA ASCENSO FÚTBOL RÁPIDO, $500 inscription and $450 per game per a search summary) did not render, and it is unclear whether that is per team or per person.
Mexico City parkrun: none; Mexico has no parkrun events.
New Haven parkrun: none in Connecticut; nearest is about 107 km away in New Jersey.
Los Angeles parkrun: none inside the city; nearest is Brea Reservoir, about 34 km away.
ZogSports New York current season: its own registration site lists no programmes; ZogSports NY is now contacted through Volo (nyc@volosports.com), so Volo's current NYC listings were used.
Toronto Sport & Social Club (now JAM Toronto) league prices: the site redirects to JAM Sports and loads leagues by script; no individual fee could be read.
Underdog Sports League Toronto: no evidence found that it operates in Toronto.
Vancouver Sport & Social Club (vssc.ca): connection refused; Urban Rec, which calls itself Vancouver's Sport and Social Club, was used instead.
Dublin Social Club / Playball Dublin: no own-site pricing found; the Irish Tag Rugby Association was used instead.
Sales tax or VAT treatment for Volo (US), GO Mammoth (UK VAT), ITRA (Irish VAT) and Shoreline Social: not stated on the pages read.
GO Mammoth per-season price: only per-week prices are published.
TUC 2026/2027 membership price: required but not read.
London City Runners start times: not on the home page.

A free weekly Dublin running club confirmed on its own site: not found (Castleknock charges €10 plus Athletics Ireland registration; Run Club Social and The Urban Run Project only on third-party pages).
A free weekly Mexico City running club confirmed on its own site: not found (Martí's free run club is monthly; Nike Run Club and adidas Runners only on third-party pages).
Parkdale Roadrunners' own website was not read; the confirmation is from the host venue's page.
